# Third chapter without a marker

A third chapter is what lets this book count. A chapter reads the store before
it rewrites its own record, so a record planted here is read by the two
chapters ahead of it and by no other — and "twice" is then neither one report
for the book nor one for each of the three chapters rendered. In a two-chapter
book both readings give one, and the fixture could not tell them apart.

This chapter marks a term too: [Nomark Three]{.index}.
